acceptance: Accepted review rows for all four tabs, with internal columns and readable `other_changes`, reach the master; conflicts and unaccepted rows are left alone and listed. (B1, B2, B3, B9)
Vendor-owned columns are copied by reference into the master; conflicts and orphan rows are reported and lead-owned columns are untouched. (B4, B5, B6)
Each named vendor's workbook is rebuilt from the new master, vendor-safe, accepted by the Vendor Workbook Updater's reader, and a re-sync gives no change. (B6, B7)
The same inputs and run date give identical bytes, no input is overwritten, and any input problem writes nothing. (B1, B8, B9)
The report accounts for every review row, vendor value, held workbook and file written. (B10)
